newsitem.title: USA: Medical Manager IPO price point now $11.
newsitem.headline: Medical Manager IPO price point now $11.

text.p: The estimated pricing point for shares of the initial public offering of Medical Manager Corp is $11, according to lead underwriter Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette.
The shares are due to be priced tonight and trade tomorrow under the symbol "MMGR". The Tampa, Florida company develops physician practice management systems.
The price point is sharply below the $13 to $15 price range estimated in a January 22 filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for the six million share offering.
Before that filing, the company had a prior document in November estimating an offering of five million shares for $14 to $16 each.
